subject: Sentra Labs — Tenant artifact sweep (prompts/outputs/logs)
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@sentra-labs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@sentra-labs.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Sweep of tenant artifacts (Sentra Labs)

Hi Karthik,

We need to initiate an on-demand sweep of Sentra's tenant artifacts in Redwood for regulatory reasons. Scope: all user-provided prompts, generated outputs, and associated request/response logs (including KV cache entries and ephemeral traces) for tenant ID sentra-prod-07.

Targets and constraints:
- Time window: as soon as possible but prefer a maintenance window; we can be flexible May 21–23.
- Retention caveats: we do NOT want any prompt/output derivatives retained in index caches or long-term logs.
- Backups/snapshots: ensure any snapshot copies (S3 or disk) containing these objects are also removed or isolated; if full removal is impossible immediately, provide remediation timeline.

Deliverables we require after completion:
1) Signed deletion manifest with SHA256 checksums for deleted objects (machine-readable CSV).
2) Operator-run execution log showing start/end and affected object counts.
3) A notarized confirmation PDF and contact for escalation.

I've attached a formal request PDF (Sentra_ERASURE_REQUEST_20290520.pdf). Please confirm receipt and next steps, including expected SLA for evidence delivery. Lucas Chen (l.chen@sentra-labs.com) will be the technical point of contact.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Data Protection
Sentra Labs

Attachment: Sentra_ERASURE_REQUEST_20290520.pdf (application/pdf, 124 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@sentra-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Sweep of tenant artifacts (Sentra Labs)

Sofia — thanks for the detailed request and the PDF. Confirmed receipt. High-level plan and clarifying questions below.

Summary of what we will do (proposed):
- Scope: prompts, outputs, request/response logs, KV cache entries, derivative indices tied to tenant sentra-prod-07.
- Approach: staged sweep with a small "canary" subset (1% of objects) first, then full sweep in the approved window.
- Evidence: we will provide a CSV manifest (object_key, object_type, sha256, deletion_timestamp), an execution log (operator ID, commands run, exit codes), and a signed PDF certificate.

Clarifying questions required before we schedule:
1) Confirm whether Sentra wants us to rotate related KMS keys immediately after deletion (recommended) or at a later controlled time.
2) Are there any legal holds or pending incidents that would require us to retain specific object IDs?
3) Do you require removal from cold-storage backups that are governed by the cloud provider retention policy? (If so, we need explicit acceptance for the remediation timeline; some backups cannot be altered immediately.)

Operational note: full sweep will cause short-lived increases in I/O and tracing events; we'll coordinate a low-traffic window. Proposed canary window: Tue, May 21 02:00–04:00 UTC; full sweep scheduled after canary success and your sign-off. Please confirm the window or propose alternatives.

I've attached our internal checklist template (karthik-erasure-checklist.xlsx) — fill any fields you want us to use for the manifest mapping. Once we have answers to the questions above and a signed authorization (DocuSign is fine), we'll book the ops run and route to the Dedicated ops queue.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference

Attachment: karthik-erasure-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 18 KB)

From: Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@sentra-labs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@sentra-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 18:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Sweep of tenant artifacts (Sentra Labs)

Karthik — thanks. Quick responses inline: 
- KMS rotation: yes, please rotate the KMS key after deletion and provide the key rotation event ID.
- Legal holds: none for tenant sentra-prod-07.
- Backups: we accept the cloud-provider remediation timeline. Please provide the estimated window for backup purge if it cannot be immediate.

DocuSign: Sofia has routed the signed authorization; link below (we'll also upload the signed copy to the ticket).

Requested confirmation items:
- Canary window ok: Tue, May 21 02:00–04:00 UTC.
- Evidence delivery SLA: courier within 48 hours of sweep completion (machine manifest + signed PDF).

DocuSign envelope: https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/XYZ1234567890

Lucas Chen
Platform Security Lead
Sentra Labs

Cc: legal@sentra-labs.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@sentra-labs.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@sentra-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 01:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sentra Labs — Tenant artifact sweep (prompts/outputs/logs)

Lucas / Sofia — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and DocuSign link. We have scheduled the canary for Tue, May 21 02:00–02:20 UTC (20-minute run) and the full sweep for Tue, May 21 03:00–04:00 UTC, pending canary success.

Operational runbook highlights (what Ops will do):
- Snapshot read: identify object keys and confirm counts.
- Canary delete (1%): remove objects from primary store and invalidate KV cache entries; capture stdout/stderr to operator log.
- Validation: run verification job that re-computes SHA256 for deleted keys (where possible) and confirms absence from index.
- Full delete: iterate tenant keys and delete; mark in manifest.csv with deletion_timestamp.
- KMS rotation: schedule immediate rotation at sweep completion; rotation_event_id will be included in final certificate.

Deliverables and where you'll find them:
- manifest.csv (object_key, object_type, sha256, deletion_timestamp) — uploaded to a secured S3 bucket and shared link provided in ticket.
- execution-log.txt (operator runbook output) — attached to the Jira OPS ticket.
- erasure-evidence-signed.pdf — signed by the operator and our compliance lead.

I've attached version 1 of the erasure runbook (erasure-runbook-v1.pdf) for your records and included the Jira link in the ticket: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OPS-12984

We'll proceed with the canary at 02:00 UTC. Ops will send interim status at canary success/failure.

—Karthik

Attachment: erasure-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 220 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@sentra-labs.com>, Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@sentra-labs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 02:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sentra Labs — Tenant artifact sweep (prompts/outputs/logs) — Completion Notice

Hi Sofia / Lucas — sending the final confirmation and artifacts from the run. Summary: canary passed (02:00–02:18 UTC), full sweep completed at 03:58 UTC. No failures; object counts and checksums in the manifest.

Deliverables attached / linked:
- manifest.csv (attached) — object_key, object_type, sha256, deletion_timestamp
- erasure-evidence-signed.pdf (attached) — signed by operator and compliance
- execution-log.txt (Jira attachment) — OPS-12984
- kms_rotation_event_id: kr-20290521-0012

Short notes:
- Cold backups: provider reports earliest purge window 72 hours; we requested expedited processing and will follow up with the provider ticket (linked in Jira).
- Recovery note: deletions are irreversible for primary store; if you need forensic imaging please advise before we finalize provider backup purge.

Attachments: manifest.csv (text/csv, 52 KB), erasure-evidence-signed.pdf (application/pdf, 98 KB)

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

P.S. If Sentra needs a notarized signature chain, we'll coordinate with legal and can produce an embossed notarization within 5 business days upon request.
